title: Vault Agent Caching：用 LocalStack + AWS 动态凭据演示缓存命中、续期托管与 cache-clear 驱逐
description: Practice Vault Agent caching on a single Killercoda host. Start LocalStack to back the AWS secrets engine, configure AppRole auto-auth, run a Vault Agent with cache + listener + use_auto_auth_token, then observe (1) two consecutive AWS dynamic IAM requests through the agent's listener returning the same lease (cache hit), (2) /agent/v1/cache-clear evicting that lease and a third request creating a new IAM user, and (3) static KV reads NOT being cached.

steps.title: 启动 LocalStack 与 AWS 引擎、配置 AppRole
启动带 cache + listener 的 Vault Agent
观察动态 IAM 凭据的缓存命中
用 cache-clear 驱逐租约并验证静态 KV 不被缓存
